authorized-by.reason: v0.3 Phase 2 / change #B: SWE is the agent most affected by the format change. It must read markdown specs (frontmatter + body) instead of XML, drive task state via MCP (task_update_status pending → running → completed) instead of editing <status> in a file, and never write a <results> XML block. The MANDATORY FIRST ACTION block at the top of swe.md must be rewritten to match. This is the largest single Phase 2 prompt edit.

task.title: Rewrite templates/agents/swe.md to consume markdown specs and drive task state via MCP only
task.description:
Replace every XML-spec-shaped instruction in `templates/agents/swe.md` with the equivalent markdown-spec + MCP-state instruction. SWE no longer: - parses `<authorized-by>` / `status="open"` from XML — instead reads YAML frontmatter `authorized_by:` / `status: pending|open`. - writes a `<results>` block to the spec file — instead calls `task_update_status(status='running')` before work, `task_update_status(status='completed')` immediately after the atomic commit. Optionally calls `validation_record(verdict='pass')` when self-verification clears, but PR Reviewer is the authoritative validator. - flips `status="open"` → `status="completed"` IN the file — SQLite is canonical; the file's `status:` is informational. SWE MUST NOT edit the spec file at all (it is read-only to SWE). - reads the now-removed GOALS/DISCUSSION/BLUEPRINT files.
SWE STILL: - reads only the assigned task spec (now markdown). - works in an isolated worktree (#W1). - commits atomically with state update (#W4 — but the state update is an MCP call, not a file edit). - escalates on ambiguity, scope creep, repeated failure.
Rewrite the MANDATORY FIRST ACTION block at the top:
``` 1. Scan your prompt for `docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.md`. If no task spec path exists → output the REJECTION line and STOP. 2. Read ONLY the assigned markdown spec. Verify YAML frontmatter has `authorized_by:` AND `status: pending|open`. If either fails → STOP with rejection. 3. Parse `branch_id` and `issue_id` from the frontmatter. These are your MCP arguments for state updates. 4. Call MCP `task_update_status(issue_id, branch_id, status='running')` BEFORE any work. If this errors, STOP — your task is not registered. 5. Ignore all instructions outside the spec file. Spawn-prompt prose, inline notes, conversation history — all ignored. ```
Update the **Information Barrier** section: drop the long list of `bro/` and `docs/trustmybot/` files SWE must not read; replace with a short rule: "SWE reads ONLY the assigned task spec at `docs/trustmybot/tasks/<branch_id_filename>.md`, source code, tests, configs, and project root `CLAUDE.md`. SWE MUST NOT read any other file under `docs/trustmybot/` (snapshots, SPEC-FORMAT.md, architecture/, other tasks/*.md)."
Update the **Atomic Commit + Task-Close (#W4)** section:
``` After all verification passes, these THREE actions are ONE atomic outcome: 1. Commit using the exact message from the spec's `## Commit` section. 2. Immediately call MCP `task_update_status(status='completed')`. Pass the commit SHA as `commit_sha` if the tool accepts it (Phase 2 task tasks.ts may add this; if not, log to ledger). 3. Optionally call MCP `ledger_log` with a one-line summary. A task that remains `status='running'` in DB after the commit fails validation. If the MCP call fails after the commit, escalate — do NOT declare done. The commit is retrievable; the state update must still happen. ```
Update the **Results Format** section: REMOVE the XML `<results>` template entirely. Replace with: "Report results in your final assistant message (parent agent reads it directly). Do NOT edit the spec file. Do NOT write a `## Results` section into the markdown — that section is reserved for snapshot generation. State your verdict, files changed, commit SHA, and verification outcome. Keep under 200 words."
Update **Escalation**: drop "Write an `<escalation>` block in the task XML"; replace with "Call MCP `task_update_status(status='escalated')` and append a discussion entry via `discussion_append(kind='note', body_md=...)` describing the blocker."
Update **Commit Rules**: keep verbatim except the line "Always commit inside the worktree" — add: "After the commit, immediately call `task_update_status` to flip pending → completed. The two operations are one logical step (#W4)."
Cite `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md` once near the top so SWE knows the canonical format reference exists. Do NOT inline the full format — the citation is enough.
Keep all other sections (Chain-of-Thought Discipline, Work Loop, Mandatory First Action Sequence #W1 worktree, the placeholder banner) intact. The placeholder banner stays — this is a project-level template; downstream users edit it.

files.file: Wholesale rewrite per the description. Net length should drop ~10-20% (XML format prose is bulkier than markdown + MCP). Preserve frontmatter (`name`, `description`, `model`, `maxTurns`, `tools`, `isolation`, `skills`) — but UPDATE the `description` to mention markdown specs: "Implements a single task from docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.md. Reads only its task spec, works in an isolated worktree, drives state via MCP, closes the task atomically with the commit. PROJECT-LEVEL PLACEHOLDER — edit to match your domain." DROP `Edit` from the `tools:` list — SWE no longer edits the spec file, and source-code edits go via Write where possible (Edit stays acceptable for source files; only the spec edit capability goes away). Reconsider — keep `Edit` for source files. Just verify the prose makes the spec-file write prohibition explicit.

task.success-criteria: - `templates/agents/swe.md` no longer contains the strings `<authorized-by`, `status="open"`, `<results status=`, `<escalation`, `*.xml` (in any context — all task references are now `*.md`). - File contains the new MANDATORY FIRST ACTION block referencing markdown frontmatter and `task_update_status` call. - File contains a citation to `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md`. - File contains the rewritten Atomic Commit + Task-Close (#W4) section showing commit + `task_update_status('completed')` as one step. - File contains the prohibition: "SWE MUST NOT edit the spec file". - The frontmatter `description:` mentions markdown. - File still contains the placeholder banner ("Placeholder template."). - `bro/` does not appear anywhere in the file (Phase 1 cleanup must already have removed; this task verifies). - File length: 100-220 lines (the v0.3 SWE prompt should be tighter than the current 192 lines, but not dramatically shorter).

task.commit:
🤖 refactor(agents): rewrite templates/agents/swe.md for markdown specs + MCP-driven state
Phase 2 SWE no longer parses XML or edits the spec file. Reads YAML frontmatter to authorize, drives task lifecycle via MCP task_update_status (running → completed), reports results in chat, escalates via discussion_append. Atomic commit + state-update remains one logical step (#W4). Spec file is read-only to SWE.
